status: Exploratory diagnostic extension after examining v2 results. Existing model rules unchanged; no independent confirmation or production freeze.

stability_evaluation.scope: Existing baseline, policy-coverage safeguard, no-policy, clipping-only, shrinkage-only, combined robust version and expanding historical mean. No new model, signal, tuning grid or forecast cap.
cohorts: all common forecast dates, including portfolio warm-up
stability_evaluation.forecast_priority: Per-asset MAE, RMSE and OOS R2 against same-date expanding historical mean; largest absolute forecast; count and frequency above the unchanged 20% inspection threshold; inspect every flagged month and asset.
stability_evaluation.portfolio_secondary: Net return, daily drawdown, turnover, costs, allocation-limit frequency and calendar-year stability using identical continuous dates and allocation rules. Never select preprocessing to recover the original 23.99% return.
stability_evaluation.cause_audit: Reconstruct January 2020 from raw policy sheet values, completed training targets, median imputation, ddof=0 scaling, selected Ridge coefficients and additive contributions. Preserve units and source dates.
stability_evaluation.selection: No automatic winner. Elimination of extreme forecasts is necessary evidence of numerical stability, not proof of better accuracy. Prefer simple benchmark evidence over highest portfolio return.
stability_evaluation.reserved_test: No 2023-onward holding month is evaluated. Final candidate, preprocessing and acceptance criteria must be explicitly frozen before any test, and the team must confirm whether that period remains unexamined.
stability_evaluation.vintages: Revised-data limitation remains. ALFRED collection is a separate deferred task.

primary_scope: all common eligible holding months through December 2022

robustness_checks.robust: Original inputs; clip training and test features to training-only 1st/99th percentiles in every fold; Ridge grid [1,10,100,1000]. No return-forecast cap.
robustness_checks.no_policy: Original inputs excluding the five policy-path fields; same dates, training minimum, tuning and allocator as baseline. Quantifies dependence on sparse policy history.
robustness_checks.clip_only: Training-fold 1st/99th percentile clipping with original Ridge grid [0.01,0.1,1,10,100].
robustness_checks.shrink_only: No input clipping; stronger Ridge grid [1,10,100,1000].
robustness_checks.supported_policy: Original Ridge grid and no clipping; a policy feature is disabled in each training/validation fold until it has 12 finite observed training values. The threshold is a fixed sensitivity setting, not a selected production rule.

diagnostics: additive feature contributions to each forecast
interpretation: No production selection, significance claim, vintage reconstruction, new horizon search, or reserved-test evaluation. Existing surprise-by-ANFCI/GPR interactions remain included. Robustness settings will not be optimized against episode returns.
timing_corrections: Every inner validation target must end by its validation decision date. Policy snapshots dated after the last trading-day cutoff are withheld in all variants.
inspection_threshold: Absolute monthly forecasts above 20% are flagged, not clipped.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of monthly net-return differences versus baseline, conditional on the fitted continuous runs
bootstrap.statistic: mean monthly net-return difference; unadjusted percentile intervals, exploratory, no multiple-comparison correction and no model refitting

inference.episode_boundary_rule: Shift starts and ends independently. Evaluate only complete windows within the common development history. Never clip requests into the reserved test or reset holdings.
inference.leave_out: Exclude each named episode from the continuous development run without retraining; compound retained months only.
inference.credit_redundancy: Report ANFCI and credit-level/change correlations on common development dates, plus expanding past-only prediction of each credit feature from contemporaneous known ANFCI level/change; 24 prior feature rows minimum. Descriptive shared information, not causal or proof of redundancy.

deferred: final production freeze and reserved-period evaluation
